notes: Read from a 600dpi render of PDF page 49; the table itself is embedded rotated 90 degrees within the page, which is almost certainly why pdftotext extracted no table content for this page (text layer absent/non-horizontal). Each lane begins at Step 6 and is filled through a lane-specific maximum step (A:12, B:13, C:14, D:15, E:16, F:17, G:17); Steps 18 and 19 have no entries in any lane, and Step 20 is a separate universal longevity figure present for every lane. Footnotes on the page: '20 semester hours = 30 quarter hours'; 'This schedule includes a legislative salary adjustment of $4,200 on all steps'; 'This schedule includes funding from the Teacher & Student Success Act as appropriated by the 2020 Utah Legislature'; 'Teachers at Title I schools may receive up to an extra $1,000 annual Title I stipend'; 'National Board Certified Teacher Stipend = $2,500'. Transcribed carefully from a high-resolution render and cross-checked across multiple crops, but recommend a human spot-check against the original PDF appendix before treating as final.
